content.text: Perform the test at normal operating fluid temperature (50 — 80°C or 122 — 176°F).
1. "D" RANGE TEST IN NORM, AND PWR PATTERN RANGES
Shift into "D" range and hold the accelerator pedal constant at 50 % and 100 % throttle valve opening positions. Push in one of the pattern selector buttons and check the following:

content.description: Shift pattern diagram showing gear positions 1st, 2nd, 3rd, OD with selector switch positions D, N, P and reverse indicator

content.text: 1 → 2, 2-3, 3-OD and lock-up up-shifts should take place, and shift points should conform to those shown in the automatic shift diagram.

items: There is no 3rd up-shift or lock-up when coolant temperature is below 35°C (95°F) and speed is under 48 km/h (30 mph).
There is no OD up-shift or lock-up when coolant is below 63°C (145°F) and speed is under 63 km/h (39 mph), or if there is a 10 km/h (6 mph) difference between the set cruise control speed.

If there is no 1 → 2 up-shift:
• No.2 solenoid is stuck
• 1-2 shift valve is stuck

If there is no 2 → 3 up-shift:
• No.1 solenoid is stuck
• 2-3 shift valve is stuck

If there is no 3 → OD up-shift (throttle valve opening 1/2),
• 3-OD shift valve is stuck

If the shift point is defective:
• Throttle valve, 1-2 shift valve, 2-3 shift valve, 3-OD shift valve etc., are defective.

If the lock-up is defective:
• No.3 solenoid is stuck
• Lock-up relay valve is stuck
